Here we define our pipeline file structure:
-- basename (usually simulation series name)
    -- iterative name 0,1,...,n (usually name of batch)
        -- realization 0,1,...,n (Initial condition)
            -- redshift a_0, a_1, ... , a_n (autogenerated by FastPM)
                -- dm dirs ("1/", "Header/", generated by FastPM), halo dirs
                    -- (in halo dirs) SHAM name 0,1,...,n (usually set name "SHAM", labeling SHAM parameters)
                        -- gal_{feature}_rlz{i}, void_{feature}_rlz{i} ("feature" is the proxy of halo mass in SHAM, "rlz" is the population of SHAM)

Example:

                                           {rlz name}    {halo dir}     {galaxy catalog}
/data/Cosmology/L1000_N1024_1000cosmo/cosmo0/rlz0/a_1.0000/rstar/SHAM0/gal_Mass_rlz0.txt
{              basename          } {ite name}     {redshift}  {SHAM name}
